name: Wilkens Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Wet Kits, HD Live Floors, and Direct Replacement Flooring are all available at Wilkens, contact us to learn more!
about:
Wilkens Manufacturing Inc. was founded in 1973 by Art Wilkens and his wife Mae in Stockton, Kansas. The company remains family-owned, with several family members active in daily operations. A second facility in Bethel, Pennsylvania supports nationwide service.

The company designs and builds live-floor trailers under the LiteWalker, LTE Fleet, and X-Treme Wide Belt product lines, using patented ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene flooring that is USDA and FDA approved. It also operates a Tarps Unlimited division that produces custom tarps for semi-trailers and farm equipment. A parts warehouse stocks direct-replacement flooring and components for its own trailers as well as for Keith Walking Floor systems, and service departments in Kansas and Pennsylvania provide repair and maintenance.

Customers include fleet operators, transportation companies, and agricultural businesses that need self-unloading trailers and custom tarp solutions. The company emphasizes custom builds tailored to specific payload and unloading requirements.

Wilkens differentiates itself through its patented flooring technology, a best-price guarantee on replacement flooring, and a nationwide parts, service, and rental network operated from its two facilities. The founding goal was to advance walking-floor trailer efficiency and fuel savings.
